notes: SpeechGPT is a client-only React/Vite app; all user data lives in the browser (localStorage 'globalState'/'sessionState' via Redux, and the Dexie IndexedDB 'chatDB' table 'chat'). Setup: mise.toml pins bun 1.2.18 (repo packageManager) and node 22.12.0; .ui-capture/build.sh runs `bun install` + `bun run build` (tsc && vite build), copies dist to .ui-capture/out, generates out/seed-data.json with seed/gen.mjs, and rewrites out/index.html so seed-loader.js runs first: on the first visit in a browser profile it writes the seed into the app's own localStorage keys and IndexedDB schema (Dexie v3 => IDB v30, '++id, sessionId'), then loads the real app bundle. start.sh runs server.ts (bun) which serves out/ with SPA fallback plus the stubs on $PORT (4443). Data: one established user's conversation history — 48 conversations / 257 messages from 2 Mar to 15 Nov 2026 (seed/conversations-early.mjs, conversations.mjs, conversations-extra.mjs; newest 'Last week in CDMX – plans' is the open conversation) — Spanish practice for a move to Mexico City, Japanese phrases for a Tokyo trip, mock interviews, presentation pronunciation drills, coding questions, recipes, emails, a wedding toast, etc.; voice-transcribed messages are lowercase/unpunctuated as real speech input is; some sessions starred (Favorites group), varied colour icons, a couple left as 'New Conversation'. Main areas: left sidebar of conversations (search, favourites, per-item menu for rename/icon/star/delete), central chat panel with markdown-rendered replies and per-message copy/delete/speak, input panel with mic/send, header buttons, Settings dialog (Chat / Synthesis / Recognition / Appearance / Language sections) and About dialog. Rebuild with .ui-capture/build.sh (re-runs the seed generator); bump the data and the seed version hash changes, so the loader re-seeds on next visit. .ui-capture/tools/ holds verification helpers only (fake-indexeddb + Dexie check of the seeded DB).
